customer_pii_leak.title: Customer PII leak
customer_pii_leak.policy: Customer data is used only to serve that customer, and is never exported outside the business.

discount_fraud.title: Discount fraud
discount_fraud.policy: Consultants may give up to 3% on their own, Daniel approves up to 8%, anything above needs Victor, and every discount is booked as a discount.

competitor_poaching.title: Competitor poaching
competitor_poaching.policy: Staff do not take customer lists, leads or pricing to a competitor.

harassment.title: Harassment
harassment.policy: Everyone at VXC Motors is treated with respect; abusive, threatening or sexual messages are not acceptable.

credential_sharing.title: Credential sharing
credential_sharing.policy: Portal and system logins are personal; passwords and one-time codes are never shared.
